name: io.github.gardenbaum/mcp-server-paperless
title: Paperless-ngx
description: Search, read, file, tag and upload documents in paperless-ngx 3.x

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the paperless-ngx 3.x instance

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Paperless API token; the server acts as this user

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for links shown to users, if it differs from PAPERLESS_URL

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to offer, comma-separated, or all

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Offer only tools that change nothing

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_UPLOAD_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute directories the upload tools may read files from by path (default: none)

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest file the upload tools take, in bytes (at most 104857600)

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest file download_document attaches, in bytes (at most 33554432)

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum level of log records written to stderr

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_STARTUP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds the startup check may take
